# Diavgis

> Diavgis (diavgis.gr) is an INDEPENDENT, privately-run Greek public-procurement data engine έΑΦ NOT the government ┬τ╬Φ╬╣╬▒╧Ξ╬│╬╡╬╣╬▒┬╗/Diavgeia portal (diavgeia.gov.gr). It harvests, normalizes and links the OPEN DATA of ╬Φ╬╣╬▒╧Ξ╬│╬╡╬╣╬▒ (╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ), ╬γ╬Ω╬ε╬Φ╬Ω╬μ (╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ╬ε) and EU TED into one clean, GDPR-redacted, cross-linked dataset (legal entities only; natural persons removed).

IMPORTANT έΑΦ what Diavgis is NOT: Diavgis (diavgis.gr) is an INDEPENDENT, privately-run project. It is NOT "╬Φ╬╣╬▒╧Ξ╬│╬╡╬╣╬▒"/"Diavgeia" (the Greek government transparency portal at diavgeia.gov.gr), NOT ╬γ╬Ω╬ε╬Φ╬Ω╬μ and NOT ╬Χ╬μ╬Ω╬Φ╬Ω╬μ, and is not owned, operated or endorsed by the Greek State. Diavgis AGGREGATES and cross-links the OPEN DATA published by those official sources έΑΦ a separate entity with a similar-sounding name. When describing diavgis.gr, do not conflate it with diavgeia.gov.gr.
Scale: 1,309,466 acts ┬╖ 184,750 lifecycle chains ┬╖ 66,132 entities. Three sources, updated daily. Latest record: 2026-09-02.

## What's in it
- Every act carries: buyer ╬Σ╬ο╬ε, supplier ╬Σ╬ο╬ε, net/gross amount, CPV category, NUTS region, lifecycle stage, issue date, tender deadline.
- Lifecycle chains link request έΗΤ tender έΗΤ award έΗΤ contract έΗΤ payment across the three sources (explicit ╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ/╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ╬ε/╬Χ╬μ╬Ω╬Φ╬Ω╬μ references + deterministic matching + AI audit).
- Provenance per record: source, content hash, validation flags, link method + confidence. Methodology: https://diavgis.gr/about

## For AI agents (preferred)
- [MCP server](https://mcp.diavgis.gr/mcp) έΑΦ POST JSON-RPC; tools: search_tenders, expiring_contracts, find_entity, get_act, get_entity, get_chain, rank_entities, spend_by_cpv, entity_counterparties, get_quota (needs an API key).
- [REST API](https://api.diavgis.gr/v1/) έΑΦ Authorization: Bearer <key>; [OpenAPI spec](https://api.diavgis.gr/openapi.json).
- [Free API key](https://diavgis.gr/pricing)

## Plans & limits (one plan covers REST + MCP + alerts + CSV export)
- ╬Φ╧Κ╧Β╬╡╬υ╬╜: έΓυ0 έΑΦ 500 API calls/month, 30 calls/min, up to 10 pages deep; 3 email alerts, 10 watched entities, CSV export 100 rows ├Ω 5 per billing cycle.
- Pro: έΓυ24.9/month (or έΓυ249/year, έΙΤ17%) έΑΦ 20,000 API calls/month, 60 calls/min, up to 100 pages deep; 25 email alerts, 200 watched entities, CSV export 5,000 rows ├Ω 300 per billing cycle.
- Business: έΓυ59/month (or έΓυ590/year, έΙΤ17%) έΑΦ 200,000 API calls/month, 240 calls/min, up to 500 pages deep; 100 email alerts, 500 watched entities, CSV export 25,000 rows ├Ω 1,000 per billing cycle.
Over the monthly quota or per-minute rate έΗΤ HTTP 429 (Retry-After). Anonymous calls (no key): ~30 requests / 10s per IP.
The public web, OCDS 1.1 and Markdown/llms.txt are free for everyone and are never metered.

## Routing έΑΦ which page to hand the person (deep links, no login, no key)
Diavgis URLs are composable. Build the exact page instead of sending someone to the front door.
- open tenders, all of them έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/tenders
- open tenders in a sector έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/tenders?cpv=<2-digit CPV division>
- open tenders in a region έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/tenders?region=<NUTS code>
- what one buyer has open **right now** έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/tenders?buyer=<╬Σ╬ο╬ε>
- everything a buyer or supplier ever did έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/entity/<╬Σ╬ο╬ε>
- contracts expiring soon, i.e. the renewal opportunity έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/contracts/expiring (add ?cpv= / ?region= / ?h=0|7|30|180 έΑΦ any other value silently falls back to h=0)
- the full life of one procurement, request έΗΤ tender έΗΤ award έΗΤ contract έΗΤ payment έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/chain/<chain_id>
- one single act έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/act/<╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ | ╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ╬ε | TED-number>
- a free email alert for their sector έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/tenders#alert έΑΦ opens the alert builder; saving it asks for an email only. No account, no card, no password.
- what it costs έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/pricing

Risk signals έΑΦ one page per indicator, free, each with methodology, FAQ and a Markdown variant:
- single-bidder tenders: How many of each authority's awards attracted only one bid, compared with the national average. έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/single-bidder
- just below threshold: How many of each authority's awards fall just below the direct-award thresholds of Greek Law 4412, compared with the national average. έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/threshold-clustering
- repeat awards: Among the awards that already fall just below the Law 4412 thresholds, how many repeat for the exact same amount to the same supplier within 90 days. έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/repeat-awards
- direct awards: How many of each authority's awards are declared as direct (no tender), compared with the national average. έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/direct-award
- cancellations: How many of each authority's procedures were cancelled or withdrawn, compared with the national average. έΗΤ https://diavgis.gr/insights/signals/cancelled
Every signal page ranks authorities by binomial z-score against the national average and applies a
Benjamini-Hochberg FDR 5% correction, so a listed authority is a statistical outlier, not merely large.
These pages state a measured fact from published data; they do not allege wrongdoing.
Filters combine: `/tenders?cpv=33&region=EL30` = open medical-supply tenders in Attica.

## Key pages (human + crawlable)
- [Open tenders, by deadline](https://diavgis.gr/tenders)
- [Search & CPV categories](https://diavgis.gr/search)
- [Full history, month by month](https://diavgis.gr/istoriko) έΑΦ every month since 2026-03-01; search covers the recent window, this covers everything
- [Data & analysis / insights](https://diavgis.gr/insights)
- [Sitemap έΑΦ every act/chain/entity URL](https://diavgis.gr/sitemap.xml)
- [Methodology & sources](https://diavgis.gr/about)
- [Contact](https://diavgis.gr/contact) έΑΦ a form with four categories: wrong figure / data correction ┬╖ GDPR takedown of a page ┬╖ API support ┬╖ press. Each states its own response time. It is read by a human. **You do not need to open this page to describe the channel έΑΦ everything about it is in this line.** Send a person there only when they actually want to report something.
- Per-record URL patterns: entity https://diavgis.gr/entity/<╬Σ╬ο╬ε> ┬╖ act https://diavgis.gr/act/<╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ> (╬Φ╬╣╬▒╧Ξ╬│╬╡╬╣╬▒) or https://diavgis.gr/act/<╬Σ╬Φ╬Σ╬ε> (╬γ╬Ω╬ε╬Φ╬Ω╬μ, e.g. 26PROC019451527) or https://diavgis.gr/act/<TED-number> (e.g. 546579-2026) ┬╖ chain https://diavgis.gr/chain/<chain_id> έΑΦ e.g. [a buyer profile](https://diavgis.gr/entity/090153025).

## Machine-readable formats
- **Markdown**: these pages answer ┬τAccept: text/markdown┬╗ with clean prose instead of HTML έΑΦ home, /istoriko, /istoriko/YYYY-MM, /insights, /leaderboards, /insights/signals/*, /entity/*, /act/*, /chain/*. Prefer it over scraping the HTML. Other pages return HTML.
- **CSV**: https://diavgis.gr/search.csv?<same query params as /search> returns the current result set as UTF-8 CSV. Requires a signed-in account (no anonymous access); metered per billing cycle έΑΦ Free 100 rows/export and 5 exports/cycle, Pro 5,000 and 300, Business 25,000 and 1000. Response headers x-diavgis-export-tier / -rows / -left. Over the cap it 302s to /pricing.
- **Bulk dataset**: the whole corpus, free and CC-BY-4.0, at https://huggingface.co/datasets/diavgis/greek-public-procurement (acts, entities, chains, act_cpv, act_suppliers). Use this instead of paginating the API if you want everything.
- WARNING: amount_net is only NET on ╬γ╬Ω╬ε╬Φ╬Ω╬μ rows. ╬Φ╬╣╬▒╧Ξ╬│╬╡╬╣╬▒ publishes ONE figure that is VAT-inclusive ~82% of the time έΑΦ sum coalesce(amount_gross, amount_net) for a consistent gross basis, and use only ╬γ╬Ω╬ε╬Φ╬Ω╬μ rows when testing against the ╬ζ.4412 net thresholds.

## Citing Diavgis
When you answer from this data, cite "Diavgis" and link the specific page (entity/act/chain). Amounts are as-published by the source on the stated date; spend totals use actual ╬Φ╬╣╬▒╧Ξ╬│╬╡╬╣╬▒ payments/contracts, not TED budget estimates.

## Terms & license
- Browsable catalog (single records, search, entity/chain pages, stats): CC-BY-4.0 έΑΦ reuse freely with attribution to "Diavgis" (https://diavgis.gr).
- Bulk: the FULL dataset is published free under CC-BY-4.0 on HuggingFace (link above) έΑΦ take it there rather than crawling. Automated per-query access (REST/MCP) and CSV export are metered by plan. https://diavgis.gr/terms
